9Q3/2025 Business Outlook
Thai Economy Outlook 2025
The Thai economy is facing pressures both domestically and internationally , leading to a slowdown in growth during 2025 –2026. The outlook is clouded by 
recession risks stemming from weak exports, an overvalued baht relative to fundamentals, and an incomplete recovery in touris t arrivals.
Source: IMF, World Bank, SCB EIC as of October 2025•Thai economy 2025, will face increasing challenges in relying 
on global demand. The 19% U.S. tariff has started to impact 
Thai exports, with several product categories already 
experiencing contractions and expected to decline further.
•Thailand’s 2H/2025 Outlook, SCB EIC forecasts GDP growth 
at 1.8% in 2025, slowing to 1.5% in 2026, with H2/25 growth 
likely below 1%, raising recession risks.
•Baht appreciation: Strongest since 1997, outpacing peers 
and straining exports and tourism due to misalignment with 
fundamentals.3.20%

Small Gas Carriers (SGC), with capacities not exceeding 5,000 
cubic meters, plays a vital role in Asia’s logistics network and 
act as a stable backbone in regional logistics networks. The 
key driver for this segment are 1. Strong Household Demand 
for LPG 2. Limited Supply in the Small Gas Carrier Market 3. 
Geographical Advantage and Operational Flexibility.
